title: Epik Donut!
body:
Epik Donut Mod! TIPS

There are 12 donut variants that can be crafted.

Regular donuts **(Dry Donut)** give the same hunger and better saturation than bread.

Donuts with fillings or extra flavor adds a **1/2** of hunger bar to a donut and raises saturation.

Golden donuts give the effect of **speed, resistance, nausea, and haste!** The nausea effect only lasts 30 seconds.

Vanilla flowers are required to make white chocolate.

The best places to find vanilla flowers is in a forest or plains biome.

If you are too lazy to craft donuts, then trade with a farmer villager for good deals for them.
